decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Location plan, reference 1205 AP001; Existing plans, reference 1205 AP002; Existing elevations, reference 1205 AP003; Existing sections, reference 1205 AP004; Proposed plans, reference 1205 AP005; Proposed elevations, reference 1205 AP006; Proposed sections, reference 1205 AP007; Planning Statement, reference: 1205 PS01 dated 08 August 2014; Received: 18 August 2015) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill and a rear roof extension with front roof windows to the house
